info.title: JuiceShop
info.description: Derived by Unwire from the static frontend code of http://localhost:3000 (Angular bundle main.js, no source map). Draft, AI-derived: review every operation.

servers.description: Web UI root (hostServer is "." in the environment, assets/main.js:1:2227)

x-unwire-open: Discover: /api-docs/ is a Swagger UI, its swagger-initializer.js points to an external example spec (petstore.swagger.io), no spec of this target; /api-docs answered 301, /api/openapi.json and /api/swagger.json 500.

Auth: login (POST /rest/user/login) answers authentication.token; the UI stores it in localStorage and a cookie 'token' (8 h) and the HTTP interceptor sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and X-User-Email on every call (assets/main.js:1:454072). Per operation auth comes from the route guards: login guard (token present), admin and accounting guards (data.role in the decoded token).
X-User-Email header: sent by the interceptor when localStorage email is set, purpose unknown.

Socket.IO: the UI connects to <root>/socket.io and emits notification received, verifyLocalXssChallenge, verifySvgInjectionChallenge, verifyCloseNotificationsChallenge; listens to challenge solved, code challenge solved, server started. Not described in this spec.
External calls left out: https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/userinfo (OAuth login), cdnjs scripts (cookieconsent, jquery), skipped by the crawl.
Navigation left out (4): window.location.replace to /profile and /dataerasure (server-rendered pages, two places each), window.open of /ftp/order_<id>.pdf (order confirmation PDF, two places).
Lazy chunks: the webpack runtime builds <id>.js; the crawl did not find 67, 745, 202, 98 and common, loaded with -Script. They hold no own API calls (web3 modules use the service in main.js).
Source maps: main.js.map, vendor.js.map and the others answered with no source map (SPA fallback), names come from the minified bundle.
Many request bodies are objects passed through from forms; their keys are not in the services, marked per operation.
